Last resort \u2014 a token too wide even split three ways: overflow-wrap:anywhere at the floor. Geometry wins,\n//      nothing is clipped in silence, and it STILL never overflows the cell (never crosses into the subject).\nfunction fitHero(inkEl, availW, singleFloor){\n  var word=inkEl.textContent, L=HERO_LADDER;\n  // Phase 1 \u2014 intact single line (largest fitting rung \u2265 singleFloor).\n  inkEl.style.whiteSpace='nowrap'; inkEl.style.wordBreak='normal'; inkEl.style.overflowWrap='normal'; inkEl.style.maxWidth='none';\n  for(var s=0;s<L.length;s++){\n    if(L[s]<singleFloor) break;\n    inkEl.style.fontSize=L[s]+'px';\n    if(inkEl.offsetWidth<=availW) return;             // whole word on one line \u2192 done\n  }\n  // Phase 2 \u2014 balanced wrap.
